ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters accounting for approximately 15-20% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular rings and rosettes distributed across the dark field; higher density of high-intensity pixels on the lateral margins and a distinct white patch at the median notch base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth extending roughly 18% into the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged continuous boundary; multiple macro-serrations with amplitudes exceeding 20 pixels; a significant semi-circular excision located on the upper margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins follow a generally convex path toward the distal tips, characterized by high fractal irregularity due to edge serration and barnacle encrustation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense mapping of circular, high-contrast white ring-shaped scars (0.5cm to 3cm scale) appearing as 'O' shaped clusters across both lobes, most concentrated on the mid-to-outer left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Localized detection of faint, non-parallel white linear tracks on the mid-section of the left lobe, intersecting the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive accumulation of calcified acorn barnacles along the trailing edges and distal tips; extensive circular scarring across the ventral plane consistent with previous parasite attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, localized white pigmentation mark situated at the base of the median notch, serving as a high-contrast focal point.
